sv-01: A poor woman kept Monday vrata with bel, water, and Om Namah Shivaya.
sv-02: Neighbours mocked; she said fruit is Shiva’s, her work is the Name.
sv-03: One Monday the lamp failed; the japa did not. Nandi appeared at the gate.
sv-04: The heart of the vrata: water, bel, truthful speech, the five-syllable Name. Local custom wins.
